verdict.rationale: Testing against a sandbox is a fair question for a fraud-prevention API like Riskified, but the evidence never documents a sandbox or test environment kept separate from production data. The only related item is the Integration Console, a validation tool that gives feedback on your API integration. That is an adjacent feature, not isolated sandbox testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Integration Console is a self-service validation tool that provides real-time feedback on your API integration.
